portInfo.description: Brazil's first capital, known for its Portuguese colonial architecture and Afro-Brazilian culture.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Terminal Marítimo de Passageiros do Porto de Salvador (Contermas) — Avenida da França, Comércio, Salvador, Bahia (southern end of organised port polygonal)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Waterfront Comércio location; Elevador Lacerda links lower city to Pelourinho. Taxi/rideshare; prices null. Steep hills and heat affect walkers.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Elevador Lacerda + Mercado Modelo — next to the terminal zone.
Pelourinho historic centre — uphill from the elevator.
Forte São Marcelo views — offshore fort named by operator.
Barra lighthouse / beaches — longer transfer; buffer required.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Budget time for the Elevador queue and the climb into Pelourinho in heat/humidity.
